description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Co-occurrence Number" on the x-axis and "ACC (%)" on the y-axis for six different data series. The x-axis employs a logarithmic scale for its non-zero values, with labeled major ticks at 0, $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The y-axis uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to above 80, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 units (60, 65, 70, 75, 80). All six series are plotted with solid lines and distinct markers, with data points occurring at approximate x-values of 3, 30, 300, and 3000. The "Base" series is represented by a black line with circle markers, showing a steady increase from approximately 61.2 at the first data point to 66.8 at the final data point. The "FT" series, shown as a blue line with downward-pointing triangle markers, rises from roughly 62.4 to 68.3 across the x-axis range. The "IKE" series, depicted by a red line with upward-pointing triangle markers, increases from about 64.5 to 70.1. The "MEND" series is indicated by a brown line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 65.8, rising to 71.2 at the second data point, and ending at 73.8. The "MEMIT" series is represented by a purple line with hexagon markers, increasing from roughly 66.3 to 72.5. Finally, a series denoted by a green line with square markers (whose legend label is obscured by a solid gray rectangle) starts at approximately 72.2, increases to 75.9 at the second data point, reaches 77.5 at the third data point, and ends at 77.6 at the final data point.
